Klaus BEERBAYER, alias L. Rubinstein and A. Bernstein,
Suspected Soviet Agents

In connection with A. De Gorgev Left Shanghai for
Tientsin on 10th inst., per s.s. "Ural Maru".
He arrived in Tientsin on 12th inst. and is now staying at
the Hotel de Pekin (formerly the Astor House). During their
sojourn here they visited M. Beerbayer's residence at
Route Pichon, No. 5, where it is believed that some
information was exchanged in connection with
transactions.

G Tcheoumshansky
D. S.

after having been seen by O/c. S.S

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL P
C & S. B. REGI
D. 162
5/8/32

Special Branch S.2.
August 5, 1932.

Memorandum on movements of L. Guterman and
A. Beerbrayer, Suspected Soviet Agents.

L. Guterman arrived in Shanghai from Tsingtao
by the s.s. "Hoten Maru" on July 30, 1932. He is
Russian of Jewish origin and a merchant by profession.
He is strongly suspected by the Chinese Authorities
in Tsingtao of being a Soviet Agent. His wife is
a sister of M.M. Shvetz a clerk employed at the local
branch of the "Dalbank".

L. Guterman is said to have come to Shanghai in
connection with the sale of Soviet goods, probably
precious stones etc. on behalf of Gostorg (Soviet
State Trading Syndicate).

In connection with this business he will be
assisted by A. Beerbrayer a jewellery dealer who
sells jewellery belonging to Gostorg on a commission
basis (file D.162).

*A. Beerbrayer also arrived from Tsingtao by the
s.s. "Hoten Maru" on July 30, 1932.

L. Guterman resides with A. Beerbrayer at Route
Grouchy, Pass. 9, house No.16.

G. Tcheremshansky
D. S.

Officer i/c Special Branch
Information.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
特务科 S.2.
1932年8月5日。

关于疑似苏联特工 L. Guterman 和 A. Beerbrayer 行踪的备忘录。

L. Guterman 于1932年7月30日乘“博天丸”号（s.s. "Hoten Maru"）轮船从青岛抵达上海。他是犹太裔俄罗斯人，职业为商人。青岛的中国当局强烈怀疑他是苏联特工。他的妻子是 M.M. Shvetz 的姐妹，M.M. Shvetz 受雇于“道胜银行”（Dalbank）当地分行的职员。

据称，L. Guterman 来上海是为了代表苏维埃国家贸易辛迪加（Gostorg）销售苏联商品，可能是宝石等。

在此项业务中，他将得到珠宝商 A. Beerbrayer 的协助，后者以佣金方式销售属于苏维埃国家贸易辛迪加（Gostorg）的珠宝（档案 D.162）。

*A. Beerbrayer 也于1932年7月30日乘“博天丸”号（s.s. "Hoten Maru"）轮船从青岛抵达。

L. Guterman 与 A. Beerbrayer 同住于古路士路（Route Grouchy）9号弄堂16号。

G. Tcheremshansky
侦探警长

特务科主管
情报。

No L. O. D. 162.
Date June 25. 1930.
REPORT
Subject (in full) Sale of Russian Jewellery, the property of Comrade
A. Beerbrayer.
Made by D.S. Tcheremshansky. Forwarded by
Sir,
With reference to an advertisement which appeared in
the China Press on June 20th and which reads:-
'GREAT DIAMOND AUCTION SALE.
Having been favoured with instructions from the Concerned,
will sell by Public Auction.
Tomorrow
Saturday, June 21st, 1930, at 2.30 p.m.
A Collection of Superb Diamonds and other Jewellery, amongst
which are:-
1 Pair Diamond Earrings of 19.37 carats.
1 Single Stone Diamond Ring of 10.16 carats.
1 Single Stone Diamond Ring of 8.38 carats.
3 other single stone rings of over 5 carats each and 2 of
over 4 carats each,'-
information has been received that these articles which were
sold on June 21, 1930 at L. Moore & Co., Auction Room, were
the property of Comrade A. Beerbrayer, a Russian jew. It
is said that jewellery in which he trades is property
confiscated by the "Gostorg" and also that received from the
special fund of G.P.U. Some of the articles were previously
exposed at Lipkovsky's "Siberian Jewellery Store," Nanking
Road.
A. Beerbrayer arrived in Shanghai from Harbin on May
21, 1930 in the s.s. "Hoten Maru." He resides at 212A
Bubbling Well Road. He also rents a flat at 82 Nanking
Road, occupied by Mr. Lipkovsky, where his wife intends to
open a dentist's office.

先生，
鉴于6月20日刊登在《字林西报》（China Press）上的一则广告，内容如下：-
‘大型钻石拍卖。
承蒙有关方面委托，
将于明日
1930年6月21日，星期六，下午2时30分公开拍卖。
一批极品钻石及其他珠宝，其中包括：-
1对重19.37克拉的钻石耳环。
1枚重10.16克拉的单钻戒指。
1枚重8.38克拉的单钻戒指。
3枚其他单钻戒指，每枚超过5克拉，以及2枚每枚超过4克拉的戒指，’-
已收到情报称，这些于1930年6月21日在 L. Moore & Co. 拍卖行售出的物品，属于俄罗斯犹太人 A. Beerbrayer 同志。据说他经营的珠宝是“苏维埃国家贸易辛迪加”（Gostorg）没收的财产，以及从国家政治保卫局（G.P.U.）特别基金中获得的物品。部分物品此前曾在南京路 Lipkovsky 的“西伯利亚珠宝店”展出。
